My strategy is straightforward: I'm in a winning position with my monopolies generating massive rent, especially Boardwalk and Park Place which can end GPT in one or two unlucky rolls. I'll just end my turn and let the rent collection do the work—GPT will eventually land on my properties and run out of cash.
